supported_furniture.source_quote:
Create a complete, editable three-dimensional bedroom from the two supplied reference images. Focus on the bed and bedding, bedside area, cabinetry, lamps, window-side space, wall layers and circulation. Match the furniture proportions, relative placement and overall character of the room.

Treat the images as different views of the same space. The bed, cabinetry and walls must remain coherent as the viewpoint changes. Ground furniture plausibly and give fabric, wood, walls and glass appropriate material properties. Build actual three-dimensional structures rather than placing the whole reference image on a plane to stand in for the room.

Model in metres with Z up. Set up and retain two cameras, matching the viewing position, direction and composition of each reference image as closely as possible. Start with a 30 mm lens and adjust framing to suit the references. Render two 669×1000 images using Cycles, Filmic, High Contrast, exposure 0 and gamma 1. Submit reproducible modeling code, scene.blend with complete textures, and main.png and alternate.png corresponding to the reference views. Render both outputs from the same scene.
supported_furniture.rationale: Task-stated setting or dimension; tolerances and geometric algorithms still need representative calibration.
